name: stats-composer
description: Per-request TPS (tok/s) and TTFT (first-token latency) stats for ZCode, shown at the position you marked: inline in the composer toolbar, next to the + button. Reads the usage DB that ZCode itself already records for every provider, so custom endpoints and all API kinds work identically. Includes a zero-context-pollution sidecar (live stats + optional composer pill injection) as an opt-in integration mode, a /stats-composer:tps command, MCP tools, and a lightweight dashboard.

mode.title: Integration mode
mode.description: auto = composer pill if remote debugging is available, otherwise assistant-attached stats. skill = assistant-attached stats only. sidecar = background live-stats server only. One of: auto, skill, sidecar.

position.title: Pill position
position.description: Where the stats pill sits in the composer toolbar. left = next to the + button. right = at the far right, near the model selector. One of: left, right.

wideCard.title: Wide session-statistics card
wideCard.description: On = the roomier hover card: wider panel, larger gutters and a looser row rhythm, easier to read. Off = the compact card that mirrors ZCode's own hover panel. Applies to the card you get when hovering the composer stats pill.

live.title: Live streaming rate while generating
live.description: In live mode, show an interpolation of the last completed request's rate while the model is still streaming.

window.title: Session window size
window.description: How many recent requests to average for the session rate (Hermes uses 10).

port.title: Sidecar port
port.description: HTTP port for the sidecar stats server (used by the composer pill and dashboard).
